PDF Merger

Combine multiple PDF files into one document. Arrange the files in any order, preview each file's page count, then merge and download the result.

Merge PDFs

Select two or more PDF files, arrange them in order, then merge them into a single PDF.

No files added yet.

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Click "Choose PDF files" and select two or more PDF files.
  2. Use the ↑ and ↓ buttons to arrange them in the order you want, or × to remove one.
  3. Check each file's page count shown next to its name.
  4. Click "Merge PDFs" and the combined file downloads automatically.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Will merging change the content of my PDFs?

Yes. Merging only appends whole documents in the order you choose. No pages are reordered, resized or altered inside each file.

How do I change the order of the files?

Use the up and down arrow buttons next to each file to move it, or the × button to remove it from the list.

Are my files uploaded anywhere?

Everything happens locally in your browser using the PDF-Lib engine. Files are never uploaded to any server.
